title: Wick Liquor Boulevard 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Boulevard by Wick Liquor is a vibrant fruit punch blend with a distinctive edge. It brings together a mix of tropical fruit flavours with the deep, tart note of Loganberry pulp, creating a punch-style vape that’s rich, bright, and endlessly moreish. This Shortfill provides 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml bottle, leaving space for two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 18mg nic shots makes 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Blended at 70VG/30PG, Boulevard is crafted for sub-ohm tanks and high-powered kits, producing dense clouds and robust flavour delivery. Made in the UK, Wick Liquor’s signature range is renowned for complex profiles that balance fruit intensity with originality, and Boulevard remains one of its most celebrated blends.
